description: Sends a message to NoctHost support in this account's own chat, on the user's behalf; the team sees it marked as sent by an AI assistant. At most 5 messages per hour per key. The support AI assistant often replies at once, and the reply comes back in the result; replies from the team arrive later in the same chat.

text.description: The message, in the user's words where possible.

name: support_send
title: Write to support
